headline: Musalem, of the Fed: The US will likely need several rate hikes
summary: St. Louis Fed President Musalem said the most likely scenario is that inflation stays elevated above 3.0% unless the Fed acts, and that the US will probably need several rate increases.
why: The Federal Reserve sets US interest rates, and expectations of further hikes affect Treasury yields, equities and the dollar.
why_moved: A Federal Reserve official said the most likely path is inflation staying above 3.0% and several rate increases being needed, which raises expectations of tighter policy.
original_headline: Musalem, de la Fed: Es probable que EU necesite varios aumentos de tasas
